whenToUse: Services where queries are fairly predictable, such as products or places.
Names whose spelling or spacing is confusing.
You want people to type less of a long query.
whenNotToUse: People must choose only from a fixed list (use a combobox).
There isn't enough data to suggest from.
The input is sensitive and suggestions shouldn't show.

alternatives.name: Combobox
alternatives.reason: Choosing only values in a list.

accessibility: The input is role="combobox" and the suggestion list a listbox.
Moving through suggestions with ↑/↓ is announced with aria-activedescendant while focus stays in the input.
Esc closes the list, and keystrokes aren't intercepted during Korean input composition.
The form has role="search" so it can be found as a search region.
